newsitem.title: USA: Storage Dimensions sees Q2 under forecast.
newsitem.headline: Storage Dimensions sees Q2 under forecast.

text.p: Storage Dimensions Inc said Thursday it expects second quarter results to fall below its earlier expectations, because of near-term softness in the PC-LAN market, price erosion on disk drive components, below plan staffing of its end-user sales force and product introduction expenses.

The company said it expects second quarter revenue to be 10 to 15 percent lower than the $20.9 million reported in the first quarter. It sees gross margin percentage between 34 and 35 percent, down from 36.4 percent in the first quarter.
Operating expenses are expected to exceed the target of $6.6 million by five to eight percent, it said.
The company also said it is projecting an unspecified second quarter loss. The consensus estimate is for a second quarter profit of $0.17 per share, according to First Call.

"While we are very disappointed with our current second quarter outlook, we remain confident that the PC-LAN market will experience above average growth over the long haul," Storage Dimensions president David Eeg said in a statement.
"We are taking swift action to mitigate the factors that are negatively impacting the company this quarter."
